articles.title: Photo: Real Madrid summer signing’s relief after bagging first goal contribution for the club
articles.summary: Real Madrid star Yan Diomandé achieved a significant personal milestone, securing his first direct goal contribution for the club on Tuesday. The player visibly expressed relief after the breakthrough performance, which is crucial for individual confidence and team dynamics under coach José Mourinho. This event highlights the pressures and triumphs in international club football.

articles.title: Underwater solar power sounds impossible, these new perovskite cells make it work anyway
articles.summary: Chinese researchers have innovated a novel solar power generation method for environments with scarce sunlight. Their breakthrough involves specially treated perovskite solar cells designed for effective operation in low-light conditions. This extends solar energy's applicability to challenging locations like deep-sea exploration or remote outposts, crucial for enhancing energy independence and technological capabilities in diverse settings.

articles.title: Quantum Systems Launches Maritime Domain, Introducing Seavex and Subvex
articles.summary: Quantum Systems is expanding its autonomous capabilities into the maritime domain, seamlessly connecting operations above and below the waterline with its existing air and land systems. This strategic move signifies advanced integration of autonomous technology across diverse environments. Such innovations are crucial for understanding future operational paradigms in areas like surveillance, logistics, and defence, making it a relevant development for aspirants.

articles.title: Rajnath Singh: Cos investing in emerging tech today will be leaders of tomorrow
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh urged companies to significantly invest in new and emerging technologies, asserting that indigenous technological prowess is crucial for a nation's future. He stressed the importance of self-reliance in advanced defence capabilities to enhance national security and economic strength, aligning with India's 'Make in India' initiative. This call underscores the government's push for defence indigenization.
